finalists.label: Dermatomyositis
finalists.why: This candidate has the most specific and decisive findings in the vignette, including violaceous erythema, diffuse poikiloderma, and dilated capillary loops, with no evidence against it.

finalists.label: Vasculitis
finalists.why: This candidate has several specific findings in the vignette, including a photosensitive eruption and violaceous erythema, with no evidence against it.

frontier_selector.why: The presence of anti-TIF-1γ autoantibodies and elevated serum IFN-β levels, along with the specific skin and nail findings, make Dermatomyositis the most likely diagnosis.
